title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
locationText: United Kingdom | Denmark | Portugal | Spain | United Kingdom
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.



Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

 - Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

 - Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

 - Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

 - Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

 - Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

 - Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

 - Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

 - Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

 - Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!




WHAT YOU BRING 


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

 - A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

 - Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

 - Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

 - Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

 - Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

 - AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

 - Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

 - The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

 - Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.




WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

 - You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

 - You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Query Planner & Reflections
description:
Be Part of Building the Future
Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com.
About the role
Dremio's Query Planner & Reflections (QPR) team owns the SQL planner and optimizer — built on Apache Calcite — and the reflections substitution engine that transparently rewrites queries to hit pre-computed materializations instead of raw source data. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll set technical direction for this system: driving ambiguous, cross-team initiatives, raising the bar through design and code review, and helping other engineers.
What you'll be doing
• Set architecture and technical direction for the Query Planner and Reflections team spanning next-generation features across OSS, Enterprise, and Cloud editions.
• Own design, implementation, and delivery of complex initiatives that cross team boundaries (Query Execution, Catalog, Datalake).
• Work deeply with Apache Calcite and Apache Iceberg, including driving contributions upstream where it benefits Dremio.
• Diagnose the hardest correctness and performance issues in query planning and reflection matching using query profiles, telemetry, and production data.
• Use AI-assisted development tools for code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis, and apply engineering judgment to validate AI-generated code through review, testing, and benchmarking.
• Design architectures that run correctly across deployment models and public clouds.
• Participate in design and code reviews and set technical standards for the team.
• Partner with Product on multi-quarter roadmap decisions and with Support and field teams on the highest-impact customer issues.
What we're looking for
• B.S./M.S/Equivalent in Computer Science or a related technical field or equivalent experience
• 8-10+ years of experience developing production-level software.
• Fluency in Java/C++ is a plus.
• Deep understanding of query planning and optimization: cost-based optimizers, rule-based rewriting, ideally hands-on with Apache Calcite or a similar framework.
• Strong database fundamentals: SQL, performance, schema design.
• Track record of driving system-level architecture decisions and leading complex, cross-team initiatives.
• Setting technical direction for the team or major component.
• Ability to evaluate tradeoffs and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.
• Ability to navigate ambiguous, cross-org problems independently; strong communication skills.
• Understanding of distributed file systems such as S3, ADLS, or HDFS; AWS, Azure, or GCP experience is a plus.
Bonus points if you have
• Experience with distributed query engines.
• Hands-on experience in query processing or optimization, materialized view matching, distributed systems, concurrency control, code generation, Apache Arrow, caching, or disk spilling.
• Contributions to Apache Calcite, Apache Iceberg, or similar open-source planner projects.
What we value
At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.
Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.
Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice.
Important Security Notice for Candidates
At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here .
Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

title: Engineering Manager - Realtime
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Realtime team at Supabase. Realtime lets developers send low-latency messages between clients, track and synchronize user state, and listen to database changes. Those three features are Broadcast, Presence and Postgres Changes. Broadcast also sends from the database and over HTTP, and clients can replay recent messages.

Realtime is a globally distributed Elixir cluster built on Phoenix. The team balances low latency, fair limits between projects, and the cost of running the service. Customers expect connections to stay up, so reliability matters as much as new features.

The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code, but you you will lead a team of experienced engineers. We do expect you to join design discussions and help set the bar for engineering quality, testing and operations.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Team & People

 - Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

 - Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

 - Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

Hiring

 - Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

 - Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery & Roadmap

 - Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

 - Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

 - Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

 - Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

 - Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

 - Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

 - Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

 - Have managed a team that built and ran a low-latency, high-connection service. Examples are WebSockets, pub/sub, messaging, presence or streaming systems.

 - Have strong technical credibility in distributed systems. We look for clustering, rate limiting, backpressure and capacity planning.

 - Have led a team through production incidents on a customer-facing service. You ran the follow-up work and kept the review blameless.

 - Understand what developers need from a real-time API or SDK, and have shipped one to customers outside your company.

 - Have experience with Elixir, Erlang or BEAM (not required but a plus).

 - Have experience with Postgres logical replication and Row Level Security (not required but a plus).

 - Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

 - Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

 - Build psychological safety and a feedback culture. You give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

 - Operate as a multiplier. You help individuals achieve more than they could alone, and you don't need to be the best technical voice in the room.

 - Coach rather than direct. You remove blockers, connect people to context, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

 - Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity and can build structure where there isn't much.

 - Communicate clearly and write well. You default to async and written, set context early, and surface risks early.

 - Are collaborative, low-ego and adaptable. You thrive with high-autonomy senior engineers who don't need you to be the smartest person in the room.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development

title: Engineering Manager - Pipelines
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Pipelines team at Supabase. Supabase Pipelines is a managed change data capture product. It copies the tables you select from Supabase Postgres to other systems, then streams later changes. The product is in public alpha, with BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckLake and Snowflake destinations.

Pipelines uses Postgres logical replication and Supabase ETL, our open source replication engine written in Rust. The team works close to the database. That means replication slots, WAL retention, initial table syncs, and the load they place on a customer's source database. The team also builds and runs the destination connectors. Correctness, ordering and recovery matter there as much as speed.

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.
We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.
Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.
Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.
By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.
We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.
We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:
• CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
• FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
• Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
• LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)
Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.
Function: Engineering
About the team
Treasury Automation builds the control layer for how money moves at BVNK. Every day, client and company funds flow across banks, blockchains and liquidity providers, in fiat and digital assets, through regulated entities in several jurisdictions. Our platform keeps that money in the right place, in the right structure and on the right rail, so it’s available when it’s needed, settled when it’s owed, and protected when it belongs to clients.
The platform turns treasury policy into automation. It decides when funds need to move, moves them, and proves that every movement is correct.
What you'll do
• Build liquidity management: track positions across every account, venue and chain, and rebalance funds automatically
• Power accurate, on-time settlement with liquidity providers and partners
• Automate safeguarding and segregation of client funds across entities and jurisdictions
• Evolve the treasury rules engine that turns policy into fund movements, for BVNK and Layer1 customers
• Design event-driven services and long-running Temporal workflows: idempotent, traceable until confirmed and auditable to the standard regulators expect
• Own production: observability, alerting, runbooks and on-call for systems that move real money
• Act as a technical leader: shape designs, raise the bar in code review, mentor engineers and help the Tech Lead set direction
What you'll bring
• Strong backend experience in Java/Kotlin building distributed systems in production
• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture (Kafka or similar) and workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar)
• A track record of building financially critical systems where correctness, idempotency and reconciliation matter
• Understanding of money movement: payments, settlement, liquidity or treasury, across fiat and/or crypto
• Comfort with cloud-native tooling (Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Grafana) and SQL/data warehouses
• Experience leading designs across teams and turning unclear business needs from treasury users into clean systems
• Bonus: FinTech and payments: Experience in payments, banking or other regulated financial services.
What we need from you:
• 5+ years of backend engineering experience in Java/Kotlin with Spring Boot.
• Strong distributed systems fundamentals — experience building microservices with event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS), relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), and caching (Redis).
• Experience with account or wallet systems — you've built or maintained systems that manage account/wallet lifecycle, state machines, or financial entity management where correctness and auditability are non-negotiable.
• Solid grasp of domain-driven design and hexagonal architecture — you can model complex domains cleanly, define bounded contexts, and build services with well-defined boundaries and interaction modes.
• API design skills — experience designing and evolving RESTful APIs that serve both internal services and external customers, with attention to backwards compatibility and developer experience.
• Collaborative and proactive communication — you work effectively with product managers, operations teams, and cross-domain engineers. You're comfortable operating across time zones in a remote-first setup.
• Production ownership mentality — experience with on-call, incident response, and operational monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus, Micrometer). You take pride in the reliability of systems you build.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and observability tooling.
• Open to participate in out of hours on call rota
Nice to have:
• Experience with multi-tenant architectures and tenant migration patterns.
• Background in embedded finance, BaaS, or payment platforms serving B2B2C models.
• Familiarity with database migrations in high-throughput systems.
• Experience with dynamic validation engines or capabilities/feature-flag systems.
• Experience with stablecoin, crypto, or blockchain-adjacent products.
What you can expect from us:
• Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
• Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
• A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
• A flexible approach

description:
About Us
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.
Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.
Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.
About the Team
We are looking for a talented and experienced engineering leader to join our team and lead the development of the SIM lifecyle management platforms.
As a Team Lead you will act both as technical authority and engineering manager, responsible for guiding technical direction, ensuring delivery, and fostering team growth. This role blends technical expertise, leadership, and strategic vision to build scalable, reliable solutions.
You'll be part of an international environment, working closely with cross-functional teams to shape and evolve our platform and digital experiences.
We value teamwork and embrace a culture of ownership—our engineers are both autonomous and accountable for their deliverables. We are deeply customer-focused and committed to building software that creates real value for our users and the business.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.
We are open to hiring for this role in Lisbon.
About the Role
• Interpret business needs from customers and stakeholders to translate technical requirements into actionable development tasks.
• Design and document scalable solutions, assessing impacts, effort and resources.
• Manage project timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure on-time delivery.
• Own the technical knowledge on the platforms that perform Over-the-Air (OTA) provisioning on our SIMs.
• Drive engineering maturity and customer-centric architecture at scale.
• Drive best practices in coding standards, code reviews, and system architecture.
• Oversee CI/CD pipelines, ensuring smooth deployments and high system reliability.
• Lead by example, mentor engineers, and support career development.
• Ensure team engagement, motivation, and continuous learning.
• Participate in recruitment and uphold engineering quality standards.
Requirements
About You
Must Have
• Proven technical leadership and people management experience.
• Strong emotional intelligence and communication skills.
• Business-oriented mindset aligning technical execution with goals.
• Ability to balance short-term delivery with long-term vision.
• Experience developing and operating scalable, distributed systems.
• Commitment to quality, testing, and full software lifecycle ownership.
• Proficiency in Go, or similar languages.
• Strong software architecture and microservices experience.
• Expertise in RESTful APIs and performance best practices.
• Deep understanding of concurrency and async workflows.
• Solid knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.
• Familiarity with event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
• Knowledge of networking principles and security.
• Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.) and DevOps tools (Docker, CI/CD, laC).
• Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
• Experience in Telecom is a plus.
Benefits
Why 1GLOBAL?
• Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
• Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
• Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
• Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
• Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
• International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
• Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
• Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.
1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
